scope: Internal normal-versus-extended turnaround workload classification → immutable expected-duration parameter; no public probabilities or incident selection

api.onsiteSim: cumulative accepted onsite duration, not absolute timestamp; agreed with timed owner
api.resolve: ResolveTurnaround(operationId) returns immutable nested TimingDecision, freezes on first resolution
api.reset: ResetRun cancels/clears pending, flight, records and decisions

arithmetic.bounds: ordered finite profile within15..45; otherwise baseline15/45
arithmetic.fallback: baseline, no probability (nullable null), captured normalSeconds
arithmetic.freeze: matching reply must already be available at base arrival; late result cannot modify immutable cached decision; missing/invalid/error/late use explicit baseline

service.question: normal_workload_regime latent normal-vs-extended observed completed-workload classification; not exact-deadline prediction
service.compactState: accepted operation/on-site durations, travelmetres/membercount/worktype, actual accepted physics/cohort observations and last8 own operation labels; provenance IDs local/echo only
service.matching: requestId,inputHash,operationId,runId,generation and captured timing profile; typed finite0..1 noul
service.deadline: 3s client and upstream,0retry; max1inflight client/service,16pending preparations,32cached service responses
service.credentials: Root-only hiddenstdin/inheritedenv per existing README; no key in Unity/source/args/logs
service.retired: /forecast returns404; no public forecast request is forwarded; historical helper not used

nativeProbeInstructions: Root stopPlay then import/compile and call kernel binder plus timed-lane binding as needed; service currently stopped until root hiddenstdin launch.
Run actual existing operation into return; kernel Prepare captures actual workload once and starts HTTP during trip. Inspect Decisions only after arrival Resolve.
With matching live normal_workload_regime noul response, verify ExpectedSeconds equals p*15+(1-p)*45 and stays within15..45. HasProbability true, InputHash/run/op matching.

With service absent or response after arrival, Resolve immediately gives Source baseline/HasProbability false/ProbabilityNormal null/ExpectedSeconds15. Repeated Resolve returns same immutable object even after response later completes.
ResetRun cancels oldflight and prevents oldrun/generation candidate adoption; no physical/control commands issued by kernel.
Timed owner verifies parked Replenishing unavailable during pause and Ready only after accepted duration; this lane did not edit countdown/controller/graph/UI.
limits: 15/45seconds are authored training balance, not real119 procedure or calibrated human/medical physics.
Expected duration is a bounded mean-regime approximation, not sampled stochastic duration or clinical success.
OpenRA adapted countdown and third-party retention belong to timed lane; not duplicated here.
No native/keys/livegateway/toolcalls by this lane; no Controller/Graph/UI/camera/building edits.
